text: Litigation and Enforcement involving Private Funds after the Global Financial Crisis states that crisis-era disputes brought the private-fund legal and regulatory regime under closer scrutiny than in prior decades. This independently corresponds to Kaal's account of post-crisis private-fund scrutiny and a more demanding enforcement environment. The proposition does not measure enforcement intensity or prove that scrutiny improved outcomes.
